ns2:course.label: Classical Ancient Philosophers
ns2:course.description: (PHIL 310) Intensive study of one ancient philosopher or the intensive study of a major philosophical problem through the consideration of a number of ancient philosophers; chief emphasis on Plato and/or Aristotle. 3 undergraduate hours. 3 or 4 graduate hours. May be repeated with approval. Students may register in more than one section per term. Prerequisite: One course in philosophy, preferably PHIL 203.
